missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Понятие' stays in the nominative as the subject. 'Сложное' is the agreeing neuter adjective, and 'очень' intensifies the difficulty.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Понятие' is the accusative direct object of 'объяснил'. As a neuter noun its accusative matches the nominative, with 'новое' agreeing.
Strategic focus: Genitive of absence. 'Понятия' takes the genitive after 'нет', stating the concept is missing. 'Этого' agrees in the neuter genitive.
Strategic focus: Dative after preposition. 'Понятию' is in the dative after 'к', expressing what the students grew used to. 'Этому' agrees in the neuter dative.
Strategic focus: Instrumental with preposition. 'Понятием' is in the instrumental after 'с', marking the concept as the object of work. 'Абстрактным' agrees in the neuter instrumental.
Strategic focus: Prepositional of location. 'Понятии' takes the prepositional form after 'в' to show where the meaning lies. 'Много смысла' uses the genitive of quantity.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Понятия' is the nominative plural subject. 'Эти' agrees in the plural, and 'связаны' is the short-form predicate, with 'тесно' adding degree.
Strategic focus: Genitive of relation. 'Понятия' takes the genitive after 'смысл', expressing the meaning of the concept. 'Не всем' is a dative naming for whom it is unclear.
Strategic focus: Genitive singular after numeral. 'Понятия' takes the genitive singular form required after 'два'. 'Новых' agrees in the genitive, and 'ввёл' names the introduction.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Понятие' is the accusative object of 'понимаю', matching the nominative for this neuter noun. 'Плохо' qualifies the understanding.
